structured.answer: Pretty much everything beyond plain index funds is "לא מחושב" for now. That covers bonds of every kind (corporate, Israel bonds, commercial paper, debt settlements), gold and ETCs, FX deposits, accounts and currency hedging plus the FX conversion fee itself, structured products, insurance savings (savings policies, manager's insurance, IRA tracks, קרן י'), pension payouts and Amendment 190, digital and managed portfolios, and REITs. Stock picking, trading, derivatives, ranking by past returns, loans and physical real estate are permanently out of scope, so it can't judge my single stocks or my FX costs.

stuck.why: Struck-through "נסגר ב־24.10.2026" lines appear next to "עוד לא נרשמו סגירות", so I couldn't tell what is closed and what isn't
Some card titles were cut off between screenshots, so a few items I only know from their description
Cards seem to be alphabetical, with no filter or total count, so it's hard to see what applies to me
